# @mono-agent/cli

Thin, provider-neutral command-line frontend for one strict
`mono-agent.config.json`. Programmatic APIs remain in `@mono-agent/core`; this
package translates command arguments and exit codes into those APIs.

Application frontend over the core infrastructure.

## Responsibility

Expose validation, selected-module diagnostics and commands, schema, explain,
inspection, and foreground start without hard-coding a runtime, channel,
product, or platform.

## Install / Usage

Existing registry artifacts under this package name belong to the predecessor
repository, not this v1 source. Do not install them during the source preview;
build this checkout through the
[workspace source setup](../../docs/getting-started/install.md) instead.

```bash
pnpm --filter @mono-agent/cli... run build
node packages/cli/dist/bin/mono-agent.js validate --config ./mono-agent.config.json
node packages/cli/dist/bin/mono-agent.js doctor --config ./mono-agent.config.json --json
node packages/cli/dist/bin/mono-agent.js config schema --config ./mono-agent.config.json --write
node packages/cli/dist/bin/mono-agent.js config explain --config ./mono-agent.config.json routing.primary
node packages/cli/dist/bin/mono-agent.js memory memory-local:audit --config ./mono-agent.config.json
node packages/cli/dist/bin/mono-agent.js auth pi:auth --module primary --config ./mono-agent.config.json
node packages/cli/dist/bin/mono-agent.js start --config ./mono-agent.config.json
```

`start` runs in the foreground. Its first line is a JSON `started` event with
the actual endpoints reported by selected channels. `SIGINT` and `SIGTERM`
drain and stop the host before the command returns.

`doctor` combines strict Core validation with bounded diagnostics from only
the selected typed modules. `auth`, `sandbox`, `runs`, and `memory` accept an
exact module-owned command name; they validate the selected slot and never
guess a provider or package prefix. `--name <command>` remains an exact alias
for the positional token, and `module command` remains the generic form.
Command results and lifecycle failures redact environment-resolved secrets;
failures retain a bounded stable code plus module, command, and phase context.

## Architecture

### Data flow

```text
argv -> runCli -> @mono-agent/core -> selected modules
```

The CLI resolves the config path, calls the corresponding core API, formats a
bounded result, and maps usage errors to exit 2 and validation/runtime errors to
exit 1. It does not discover or import concrete modules itself.

### Package structure

| Module | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `src/index.ts` | Public `runCli` API and I/O contracts. |
| `src/cli.ts` | Argument parsing, result formatting, and foreground lifecycle. |
| `src/bin/mono-agent.ts` | Minimal executable wrapper. |

## Public API

### Start here

| Export | Use |
| --- | --- |
| `runCli(argv, io?)` | Invoke the CLI without spawning a process. |
| `CliIo` | Supply deterministic output, working directory, and signal handling. |
| `CliSignalSource` | Adapt graceful shutdown to a process or a test harness. |

## Dependency Boundary

Depends only on `@mono-agent/core`. It contains no concrete runtime, channel,
memory, state, exporter, sandbox, renderer, or service-manager dependency.

## What This Package Does Not Own

It does not define configuration schemas, load modules, execute turns,
implement authentication or maintenance, install packages or skills,
supervise background services, or implement provider/channel behavior.
